newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian share trade lower, Unibanka still leads.
newsitem.headline: Latvian share trade lower, Unibanka still leads.

text.p: Latvian shares were quieter on Tuesday with market turnover lower although usual market leader Unibanka was still most active and climbed higher in price.
Total market turnover came to 139,532 lats against 158,914 on January 10.
Unibanka traded 54,558 lats and gained 10 santimes to 2.70 lats while on the secondary list Daugavpils Chain maker was the most active on volume of 25,295 lats as it rose six santimes to 1.25 lats.
Confectioner Staburadze, among the other two main official list shares gained both in volume and price.
It turned over 17,556 lats against 11,642 on January 10. It ended higher at 2.35 lats against 2.31 lats.
The Riga Transport Fleet was unchanged at one lat as it traded 19,527 lats of stock.
Elsewhere on the secondary list fish canneries Salacgriva 95 and Kaija were well-traded.
Salacgriva gained to 2.35 lats versus 2.30 and turned over 10,011 lats while Kaija had volume of 4,514 lats gaining one santime to 1.22 lats.
The Lode Brick firm traded 3,153 lats and rose to 1.23 lats from 1.21.
Jekabpils Sugar and the Roja Fish cannery were above 1,000 lats volume.
They traded 1,650 lats and 1,550 lats respectively. Jekabpils gained four santimes to 33 santimes and Roja ended higher at 1.25 lats against 1.19 lats.
